Trophäen.

English: Pacifica lost her dad's hunting trophies while she was redecorating her room with more mirrors.

English: Find and collect Jeff's lost diary pages.

English: Talk with Gravity Falls citizens to discover the owner of these diary pages.

English: According to his diary pages, Jeff thinks Pacifica Northwest may be the next potential Gnome Queen.
French: Dans son journal, Jeff dit que Pacifica Northwest pourrait être la prochaine reine des gnomes.
Japanese: [!TR] According to his diary pages, Jeff thinks Pacifica Northwest may be the next potential Gnome Queen.
German: Laut seinen Tagebuchseiten glaubt Jeff, Pacifica Northwest könnte die nächste Zwergenkönigin sein.
Spanish: Según las páginas de su diario, Jeff cree que Pacífica Northwest puede ser la próxima Reina Gnomo.
Italian: Stando al suo diario, Jeff pensa che Pacifica Northwest sarà la prossima Regina degli gnomi.
Turkish: Günlük sayfalarına göre Jeff, Pacifica Northwest'in sıradaki Cüce Kraliçesi olabileceğini düşünüyor.

English: Find and collect Shmebulock's lost philosophy books.
French: Trouve les livres de philosophie que Shmebulock a perdus et récupère-les.

German: Finde und sammle Shmebulocks verlorene Philosophie-Bücher.

Italian: Trova e raccogli i libri di filosofia perduti di Shmebulock.

English: Talk with Gravity Falls citizens to discover the owner of these philosophy books.
French: Parle aux habitants de Gravity Falls pour découvrir à qui appartiennent ces livres de philosophie.

English: Shmebulock builds imaginary friends from stacks of philosophy books.
French: Shmebulock se crée des amis imaginaires à partir de piles de livres de philosophie.
Japanese: [!TR] Shmebulock builds imaginary friends from stacks of philosophy books.
German: Shmebulock baut Fantasiefreunde aus Stapeln von Philosophie-Büchern.
Spanish: Shmebulock crea amigos imaginarios a partir de montañas de libros de filosofía.
Italian: Shmebulock costruisce amici immaginari con cataste di libri di filosofia.
Turkish: Shmebulock, felsefe kitaplarını üst üste dizip hayalî arkadaşlar yapıyor.

French: Pile de cristal

English: Ancient power cell, origin unknown. The crystal inside seems to have regenerative properties.
French: Pile ancienne, origine inconnue. Son cristal semble avoir des propriétés régénératrices.
Japanese: [!TR] Ancient power cell, origin unknown. The crystal inside seems to have regenerative properties.
German: Uralte Energiezelle. Der Kristall darin scheint regenerative Eigenschaften zu haben.
Spanish: Antigua pila, origen desconocido. El cristal de dentro parece tener propiedades regenerativas.
Italian: Antica fonte d'energia di origine ignota. Il cristallo all'interno sembra avere proprietà rigenerative.
Turkish: Kökeni bilinmeyen eski bir güç hücresi. İçindeki kristalin yenileyici özellikleri var gibi.

French: Magnétite azur
Cette pierre est naturellement magnétique !
German: Ein von Natur aus magnetischer Stein!
Spanish: ¡Esta piedra es magnética de forma natural!
Italian: Questa roccia è dotata di un magnetismo naturale!

French: Magnétite verte

English: Another magnetic rock. Use with caution around Mabel's braces.
French: Une autre pierre magnétique. Ne l'approche pas trop de l'appareil dentaire de Mabel !
Japanese: [!TR] Another magnetic rock. Use with caution around Mabel's braces.
German: Noch ein magnetischer Stein. In Gegenwart von Mabels Zahnspange vorsichtig verwenden.
Spanish: Otra piedra magnética. Úsala con cuidado alrededor de la ortodoncia de Mabel.
Italian: Un'altra roccia magnetica. Da usare con cautela nelle vicinanze dell'apparecchio ortodontico di Mabel.
Turkish: Bir manyetik taş daha. Mabel'ın diş tellerinin yanında dikkatli kullan.

French: Ficelle résistante

English: Thin, strangely unbreakable twine. Origin unknown.
French: Ficelle fine mais étonnamment incassable. Origine inconnue.
Japanese: [!TR] Thin, strangely unbreakable twine. Origin unknown.
German: Dünnes, seltsamerweise unzerstörbares Garn. Ursprung unbekannt.
Spanish: Fino cordel extrañamente irrompible. Origen desconocido.
Italian: Uno spago sottile, stranamente indistruttibile. Origine ignota.
Turkish: İnce ama tuhaf biçimde kopmayan bir sicim. Kökeni bilinmiyor.

French: Idole oiseau

English: Odd little stuffed birds carrying spears. Did ancient cave dwellers worship this?
French: Vieux oiseaux en peluche portant des lances. Les hommes des cavernes vénéraient vraiment ces choses ?
Japanese: [!TR] Odd little stuffed birds carrying spears. Did ancient cave dwellers worship this?
German: Seltsame, kleine, ausgestopfte Vögel mit Speeren. Ob Höhlenbewohner sie angebetet haben?
Spanish: Extraños pajaritos de peluche con lanzas. ¿Los antiguos cavernícolas adoraban esto?
Italian: Strani uccellini impagliati che reggono lance. Forse erano venerati da antichi cavernicoli?
Turkish: Mızrak taşıyan tuhaf, küçük doldurulmuş kuşlar. Eski mağara insanları buna mı tapıyordu?

French: Arbalète préhistorique

English: It’s already been mounted for display. Was this a ceremonial weapon?
French: Elle est déjà prête à être exposée. S'agissait-il d'une arme de cérémonie ?
Japanese: [!TR] It’s already been mounted for display. Was this a ceremonial weapon?
German: Sie wurde zur Ausstellung präpariert. Vielleicht eine zeremonielle Waffe?
Spanish: Ya está preparada para ser expuesta. ¿Era un arma ceremonial?
Italian: È già stata predisposta per l'esposizione. Si trattava forse di un'arma cerimoniale?
Turkish: Sergilenmeye hazır biçimde monte edilmiş. Törensel bir silah mıydı?

French: Papillon de bronze

English: Would probably fetch a fancy price at the swap meet. Stan can fill in the backstory.
French: On en tirerait un bon prix dans une brocante. Stan connaît son histoire par cœur.
Japanese: [!TR] Would probably fetch a fancy price at the swap meet. Stan can fill in the backstory.
German: Würde bei der Tauschbörse sicher einen netten Preis erzielen. Stan weiß mehr über die Vorgeschichte.
Spanish: Se le podría sacar un buen precio en el encuentro de trueques. Stan puede inventarse su historia.
Italian: Avrebbe un bel prezzo al mercato delle pulci. Stan può inventare qualche storia sulle sue origini.
Turkish: Bit pazarında iyi para eder. Geçmiş hikâyesini Stan uydurur.

French: Interrupteur

English: The module on the bottom appears intact.
French: Le module sur la partie inférieure a l'air intact.
Japanese: [!TR] The module on the bottom appears intact.
German: Das Modul an der Unterseite scheint intakt zu sein.
Spanish: El módulo de abajo parece intacto.
Italian: Il modulo sul fondo appare intatto.

French: Prise

English: It's not wired for electricity, but it may work with another power source.
French: Pas reliée à l'électricité. Elle peut fonctionner avec une autre source d'énergie.
Japanese: [!TR] It's not wired for electricity, but it may work with another power source.
German: Nicht elektrisch verkabelt, funktioniert aber vielleicht mit anderen Energiequellen.
Spanish: No está conectado a la electricidad pero puede que funcione con otra fuente de energía.
Italian: Non è collegata alla rete elettrica ma potrebbe funzionare con un'altra fonte di energia.
Turkish: Elektriğe bağlı değil ama başka bir güç kaynağıyla çalışabilir.

French: Ressort prismoïde

English: Bends light as it contracts, perhaps giving it a magical strength.
French: Courbe la lumière lorsqu'il se contracte, pouvant lui octroyer une force magique.
Japanese: [!TR] Bends light as it contracts, perhaps giving it a magical strength.
German: Biegt sich leicht beim Zusammenziehen, was ihr vielleicht magische Stärke verleiht.
Spanish: Curva la luz conforme se contrae, quizás dándole fuerza mágica.
Italian: Piega la luce quando si contrae, e forse questo le dona una forza magica.
Turkish: Sıkışırken ışığı büküyor; belki de gücünü bundan alıyor.

French: Équipement ancien

English: The inscription is obscured by years of corrosion.
French: L'inscription est illisible à cause des années de corrosion.
Japanese: [!TR] The inscription is obscured by years of corrosion.
German: Durch Jahre der Verwitterung wurde die Inschrift unleserlich.
Spanish: La inscripción está tapada por años de corrosión.
Italian: L'iscrizione è resa illeggibile da anni di corrosione.
Turkish: Yılların aşındırması yazıyı okunmaz hâle getirmiş.

French: Vis à trois branches

English: Made of strange bluish metal, with a curious pattern on its head.
French: D'une étrange couleur bleue métallisée et dotée d'un symbole curieux sur sa partie supérieure.
Japanese: [!TR] Made of strange bluish metal, with a curious pattern on its head.
German: Aus seltsam bläulichem Metall mit einem eigentümlichen Muster auf dem Kopf.
Spanish: Hecho con un extraño metal azulado, con un curioso adorno en su cabeza.
Italian: Realizzata con uno strano metallo bluastro, sfoggia un curioso motivo sulla testa.
Turkish: Tuhaf, mavimsi bir metalden yapılmış; başında ilginç bir desen var.

French: Champignon fossilisé

English: Giant mushroom with a weird striped pattern. It's so old, the roots have petrified.
French: Champignon géant étrange avec ses rayures. Il est si ancien que ses racines sont pétrifiées.
Japanese: [!TR] Giant mushroom with a weird striped pattern. It's so old, the roots have petrified.
German: Riesiger Pilz mit merkwürdigem Streifenmuster. Er ist so alt, dass die Wurzeln versteinert sind.
Spanish: Champiñón gigante con un raro adorno a rayas. Es tan antiguo que las raíces se han petrificado.
Italian: Fungo gigante con una curiosa striatura. È così vecchio che le sue radici si sono pietrificate.
Turkish: Garip çizgili dev bir mantar. O kadar eski ki kökleri taşlaşmış.

French: Hybride mystérieux

English: Part duck? Part beaver? Hard to say. Stan might have thrown this out and forgot about it.
French: Moitié canard, moitié castor ? Stan l'a sans doute jeté avant d'oublier son existence.
Japanese: [!TR] Part duck? Part beaver? Hard to say. Stan might have thrown this out and forgot about it.
German: Halb Ente, halb Biber? Schwer zu sagen. Vielleicht hat Stan sie weggeworfen und vergessen.
Spanish: ¿Mitad pato? ¿Mitad castor? Difícil de decir. Stan debe de haber tirado esto y se le ha olvidado.
Italian: È un'anatra? È un castoro? Chi lo sa! Forse Stan l'ha gettato via e se n'è dimenticato.
Turkish: Biraz ördek, biraz kunduz mu? Belli değil. Stan atıp sonra unutmuş olabilir.

French: Griffe animale

English: Did this belong to a majestic beast that roamed Gravity Falls long ago?
French: Aurait-elle appartenu à une bête majestueuse qui errait dans Gravity Falls il y a bien longtemps ?
Japanese: [!TR] Did this belong to a majestic beast that roamed Gravity Falls long ago?
German: Gehörte sie einmal zu einer Bestie, die vor langer Zeit in Gravity Falls lebte?
Spanish: ¿Esto pertenecía a una bestia majestuosa que deambulaba por Gravity Falls hace mucho?
Italian: Forse apparteneva a una maestosa creatura che abitava Gravity Falls secoli fa?
Turkish: Bu, çok eskiden Esrarengiz Kasaba'da dolaşan görkemli bir yaratığa mı aitti?

French: Nuage en pot

English: Was this tiny cloud extracted from a real one, or grown by alchemic means?
French: Ce mini-nuage aurait-il été extrait d'un vrai nuage ou a-t-il été créé chimiquement ?
Japanese: [!TR] Was this tiny cloud extracted from a real one, or grown by alchemic means?
German: Stammt diese winzige Wolke aus einer echten oder wurde sie alchemistisch erschaffen?
Spanish: ¿Esta nubecita fue extraída de una de verdad o creada por medios químicos?
Italian: Sarà stata ricavata da una nuvola reale o creata con l'alchimia?
Turkish: Bu minik bulut gerçek bir buluttan mı alındı, yoksa simyayla mı üretildi?

French: Casque serti de bijoux

English: Far too fancy for real fighting, this helmet must have been used only for show.
French: Bien trop joli pour combattre réellement, ce casque ne devait servir qu'à décorer.
Japanese: [!TR] Far too fancy for real fighting, this helmet must have been used only for show.
German: Viel zu chic für den Kampf. Er muss nur zur Schau getragen worden sein.
Spanish: Demasiado sofisticado para peleas de verdad. Este casco debe de haber sido solo de exposición.
Italian: Troppo chic per la guerra. Probabilmente aveva soltanto una funzione decorativa.
Turkish: Gerçek dövüş için fazlasıyla süslü. Herhâlde yalnızca gösteriş içindi.

French: Vase de la terreur

English: Something about this vase creeps me out. Every time I look at it, I hear voices!
French: Ce vase me donne la chair de poule. Chaque fois que je le regarde, j'entends des voix !
Japanese: [!TR] Something about this vase creeps me out. Every time I look at it, I hear voices!
German: Irgendwas an dieser Vase macht mir Angst. Wenn ich sie anschaue, höre ich Stimmen!
Spanish: Algo de esta vasija me da yuyu. ¡Cada vez que la miro, escucho voces!
Italian: Questo vaso ha qualcosa che mi inquieta. Ogni volta che lo guardo sento delle voci!
Turkish: Bu vazoda beni ürküten bir şey var. Ne zaman baksam sesler duyuyorum!

French: Tube scintillant

English: Hard to say what's making it shine, but it glows even in pure daylight.
French: Difficile de savoir ce qui le fait briller, mais il scintille même en plein jour.
Japanese: [!TR] Hard to say what's making it shine, but it glows even in pure daylight.
German: Schwer zu sagen, was es zum Strahlen bringt, aber es leuchtet sogar im Tageslicht.
Spanish: Es difícil decir lo que lo hace brillar, pero resplandece a plena luz del día.
Italian: Non si sa cosa lo faccia brillare, ma la sua luce è visibile anche di giorno.
Turkish: Neden parladığı belli değil ama gün ışığında bile ışıldıyor.

French: Plante-capsule

English: Its tough, sack-like pod is filled with an unknown liquid. Is it a nutrient or a poison?
French: En forme de sac, elle est remplie d'un liquide inconnu : substance nutritive ou poison ?
Japanese: [!TR] Its tough, sack-like pod is filled with an unknown liquid. Is it a nutrient or a poison?
German: Die harte, sackartige Hülse enthält eine unbekannte Flüssigkeit.
Spanish: Su resistente vaina en forma de saco está llena de un líquido desconocido. ¿Es un nutriente o un veneno?
Italian: Questo duro baccello a forma di sacco è pieno di un liquido ignoto: sostanza nutritiva o veleno?
Turkish: Sert, kese gibi kapsülü bilinmeyen bir sıvıyla dolu. Besin mi, zehir mi?

French: Patin d'argile

English: Either an ancient artifact, or someone's project from Ceramics class.
French: Ancien artéfact, ou projet d'un élève du cours de céramique.
Japanese: [!TR] Either an ancient artifact, or someone's project from Ceramics class.
German: Entweder ein historisches Artefakt oder ein Projekt aus dem Töpferkurs.
Spanish: O un artefacto antiguo o el proyecto de la clase de cerámica de alguien.
Italian: Saranno un antico manufatto o il prodotto di un corso di ceramica?
Turkish: Ya antik bir eser ya da birinin seramik dersi projesi.

French: Roue à glyphes

English: Vaguely smells like chocolate. Don't attempt decoding on an empty stomach.
French: Rappelle vaguement l'odeur du chocolat. Mieux vaut avoir mangé avant d'essayer de les décoder.
Japanese: [!TR] Vaguely smells like chocolate. Don't attempt decoding on an empty stomach.
German: Riecht dezent nach Schokolade. Nicht auf leeren Magen entziffern.
Spanish: Huele un poco a chocolate. No intentes descifrarla con el estómago vacío.
Italian: Ha un vago odore di cioccolato. Non provare a decifrarla a stomaco vuoto.
Turkish: Hafiften çikolata kokuyor. Aç karnına çözmeye çalışma.

French: Gemulette du vent

English: Legendary gem-amulet thing, said to channel the elemental powers of wind!
French: Amulette avec gemme légendaire qui diffuse, dit-on, les forces élémentaires du vent !
Japanese: [!TR] Legendary gem-amulet thing, said to channel the elemental powers of wind!
German: Legendäres Juwelen-Amulett-Ding. Kanalisiert angeblich die Elementarkräfte des Windes!
Spanish: Especie de gema-amuleto legendario. ¡Se dice que conduce los poderes del viento!
Italian: Una gemma-amuleto leggendaria o giù di lì. Pare che convogli i poteri elementali del vento!
Turkish: Rüzgârın element gücünü yönlendirdiği söylenen efsanevi bir mücevher-muska şeyi!

French: Gemulette de l'eau

English: Obtained by defeating a giant beast we had no business fighting!
French: Obtenue après avoir vaincu une bête géante qui ne nous avait pourtant rien fait !
Japanese: [!TR] Obtained by defeating a giant beast we had no business fighting!
German: Nach dem Sieg über eine riesige Bestie erhalten, die wir nicht hätten bekämpfen sollen!
Spanish: ¡Obtenido por derrotar a una bestia gigante que no debíamos atacar!
Italian: Ottenuto sconfiggendo una belva gigante che non avremmo dovuto affrontare!
Turkish: Hiç bulaşmamamız gereken dev bir yaratığı yenerek aldık!

French: Gemulette de la terre

English: Ripped from a boulder-throwing beast. Said to harness the energies of the earth itself!
French: Extraite d'une bête lanceuse de rochers. On dit qu'elle exploiterait les énergies de la terre !
Japanese: [!TR] Ripped from a boulder-throwing beast. Said to harness the energies of the earth itself!
German: Einer Felsen werfenden Bestie abgenommen. Soll die Energien der Erde selbst kanalisieren!
Spanish: Arrebatado a una bestia lanzadora de piedras. ¡Se dice que emplea las propias energías de la tierra!
Italian: Strappato a una belva lancia-massi. Si dice che contenga l'energia della terra stessa!
Turkish: Kaya fırlatan bir yaratıktan söküldü. Dünyanın enerjisini kullandığı söyleniyor!

French: Gemulette du feu

English: The final Gemulet to complete the set, retrieved by smacking down a fire-flinging beast.
French: Dernière Gemulette qui vient compléter le lot. Récupérée après avoir battu une bête lançant du feu.
Japanese: [!TR] The final Gemulet to complete the set, retrieved by smacking down a fire-flinging beast.
German: Das letzte Juwulett im Set. Erhalten nach dem Sieg über eine Feuer schleudernde Bestie.
Spanish: Gemuleto final que completa la serie, recuperado tras vencer a una bestia lanzadora de fuego.
Italian: L'ultimo gemuleto della serie, ottenuto mettendo KO una belva fiammeggiante.
Turkish: Seti tamamlayan son Gemulet. Ateş saçan bir yaratığı pataklayınca ele geçti.

French: Fragment du vent

English: Clove from the Wind Gemulet by Dark Jeff to power his Waddles clone station.
French: Extrait de la Gemulette du vent pour alimenter la station de clonage de Waddles.
Japanese: [!TR] Clove from the Wind Gemulet by Dark Jeff to power his Waddles clone station.
German: Splitter aus dem Wind-Juwulett vom Dunklen Jeff für den Betrieb seiner Schwabbel-Klonstation.
Spanish: Fragmento del Gemuleto de Viento de Jeff Oscuro, da energía a su estación de clones de Bamboleos.
Italian: Ricavato dal Gemuleto del Vento dal Jeff Oscuro per caricare la stazione clona-Dondolo.
Turkish: Karanlık Jeff'in Paytak klonlama istasyonuna güç vermek için Rüzgâr Gemuleti'nden kopardığı parça.

French: Crochet auto

English: Seeks out most hook-shaped objects and latches on to them.
French: Recherche les objets en forme de crochet et s'accroche à eux.
Japanese: [!TR] Seeks out most hook-shaped objects and latches on to them.
German: Erkennt die meisten hakenförmigen Objekte und hängt sich an sie.
Spanish: Busca los objetos más parecidos a un gancho y se engancha a ellos.
Italian: Cerca oggetti a forma di gancio e vi si aggancia automaticamente.
Turkish: Kanca biçimli nesneleri bulup çoğuna otomatik olarak tutunur.

French: Crochet puissant

English: Easily yanks heavy objects aside using a powerful motor.
French: Grâce à son moteur puissant, il tracte facilement d'un coup sec les objets lourds.
Japanese: [!TR] Easily yanks heavy objects aside using a powerful motor.
German: Zieht mit einem kraftvollen Motor schwere Objekte spielend leicht zur Seite.
Spanish: Aparta objetos pesados fácilmente utilizando un potente motor.
Italian: Sposta facilmente gli oggetti pesanti grazie a un potente motore.
Turkish: Güçlü motoruyla ağır nesneleri kolayca kenara çeker.

French: Crochet céleste

English: Magically latches onto odd, hook shaped clouds floating around town.
French: S'accroche comme par magie aux nuages en forme de crochet qui flottent sur la ville.
Japanese: [!TR] Magically latches onto odd, hook shaped clouds floating around town.
German: Hängt sich magisch an seltsame hakenförmige Wolken in der Stadt.
Spanish: Mágicamente se engancha a extrañas nubes en forma de gancho que flotan por la ciudad.
Italian: Si aggancia magicamente a strane nuvole a forma di gancio che fluttuano sopra la città.
Turkish: Kasabanın üstünde süzülen kanca biçimli tuhaf bulutlara sihirli biçimde tutunur.

French: Lumière explosive

English: Its high-powered beam is amplified when aimed through crystal deposits.
French: Son rayon puissant est amplifié lorsqu'il est orienté sur des dépôts de cristaux.
Japanese: [!TR] Its high-powered beam is amplified when aimed through crystal deposits.
German: Sein extrem starker Strahl wird noch heftiger, wenn er auf Kristallvorkommen gerichtet wird.
Spanish: Su rayo de alta potencia se amplifica cuando se apunta hacia depósitos de cristales.
Italian: Il suo raggio potenziato si amplifica quando attraversa depositi di cristallo.
Turkish: Yüksek güçlü ışını kristal yataklarından geçerken daha da güçlenir.

French: Lumière rétrécissante

English: Precisely tuned to shrink me down to mouse size and grow me back!
French: Réglée avec précision pour me réduire à la taille d'une souris avant de retrouver ma taille initiale !
Japanese: [!TR] Precisely tuned to shrink me down to mouse size and grow me back!
German: Genau eingestellt, mich zur Größe einer Maus zu schrumpfen und wieder wachsen zu lassen!
Spanish: ¡Ajustada con precisión para encogerme hasta el tamaño de un ratón y volver a crecer de nuevo!
Italian: Calibrata per ridurmi alle dimensioni di un topo e poi farmi tornare normale!
Turkish: Beni fare boyuna küçültüp sonra eski hâlime döndürmek için hassas ayarlı!

French: Lumière magique
Hautement expérimentale. À manier avec précaution !

French: Gnome sauvage

English: Outcasts from gnome society, these gnomes are ferocious, but can be defeated with a few solid hits.

Italian: Questi ferocissimi gnomi, reietti della loro società, possono essere sconfitti con pochi colpi ben piazzati.

French: Gnome obscur

English: Dark Jeff's mindless thralls, Dark Gnomes attack with blinding rage. Charge Whip their auras, then jump on their heads to slow them down.
French: Ils sont aveuglés par la colère. Un Coup de fouet sur l'aura et un saut sur la tête les ralentiront.

Italian: Schiavi del Jeff Oscuro. Usa la frusta caricata sulle aure e saltagli in testa per rallentarli.

French: Mousse obscur

French: Wendy obscure

English: This Wendy clone is so cool, it hurts! Avoid the downpour of throwing axes and Charge Whip its aura away!

French: Waddles obscur

German: Schneidet dir den Weg mit Feuer ab! Verwende Dippers Superschlag, um die Kugeln zurückzuschlagen!

Italian: Ti blocca la strada con il fuoco! Usa il pugno caricato di Dipper per rispedirgli in faccia quei proiettili!
Turkish: Yolunu ateşle kapatıyor! Topakları geri göndermek için Dipper'ın Yüklü Yumruğunu kullan!

English: This one shoots fire! Use Dipper's Charge Punch to shoot the pellets back!
French: Celui-ci lance du feu ! Utilise l'Attaque coup-de-poing de Dipper pour renvoyer des boulettes !
Japanese: [!TR] This one shoots fire! Use Dipper's Charge Punch to shoot the pellets back!
German: Schießt mit Feuer um sich! Verwende Dippers Superschlag, um die Kugeln zurückzuschlagen!
Spanish: ¡Este lanza fuego! ¡Usa el puñetazo de Dipper para disparar las bolas de vuelta!
Italian: Questo spara fuoco! Usa il pugno caricato di Dipper per rispedirgli in faccia quei proiettili!
Turkish: Bu ateş püskürtüyor! Topakları geri göndermek için Dipper'ın Yüklü Yumruğunu kullan!

English: Wait until its fire dies down, then jump over to avoid it.
French: Attends que les flammes s'éteignent puis saute par-dessus pour l'éviter.
Japanese: [!TR] Wait until its fire dies down, then jump over to avoid it.
German: Warte, bis das Feuer erlischt, und spring dann drüber, um auszuweichen.
Spanish: Espera hasta que su fuego se apague, después salta para esquivarlo.
Italian: Aspetta che le fiamme si abbassino, poi saltaci sopra per evitarle.
Turkish: Ateşinin azalmasını bekle, sonra üzerinden atlayıp kaç.

English: Wait until its fire dies down, then jump over to avoid it. Stay away from its sideways blasts!
French: Quand les flammes s'éteignent, saute par-dessus pour l'éviter. Évite les explosions latérales !
Japanese: [!TR] Wait until its fire dies down, then jump over to avoid it. Stay away from its sideways blasts!
German: Warte, bis das Feuer erlischt, dann spring drüber, um auszuweichen. Vermeide seitliche Feuerstöße!
Spanish: Espera hasta que su fuego se apague, salta para esquivarlo. ¡Mantente alejado de sus explosiones laterales!
Italian: Aspetta che le fiamme si abbassino, poi saltaci sopra per evitarle. Occhio alle fiammate laterali!
Turkish: Ateşi azalınca üzerinden atla. Yanlara savurduğu alevlerden uzak dur!

English: Watch out! This one comes after you. Stay away from its sideways blasts!
French: Attention ! Celui-ci te poursuit. Ne t'approche pas de ses explosions latérales.
Japanese: [!TR] Watch out! This one comes after you. Stay away from its sideways blasts!
German: Vorsicht! Dieser Gegner verfolgt dich. Halte dich von seitlichen Feuerstößen fern!
Spanish: ¡Cuidado! Este va detrás de ti. ¡Mantente alejado de sus explosiones laterales!
Italian: Attenzione! Questo ti insegue! Occhio alle fiammate laterali!
Turkish: Dikkat! Bu peşine düşüyor. Yanlara savurduğu alevlerden uzak dur!

English: Jump over its flying attack, and jump on its head to slow it down.
French: Saute par-dessus son attaque volante puis saute-lui sur la tête pour le ralentir.
Japanese: [!TR] Jump over its flying attack, and jump on its head to slow it down.
German: Spring über den Flugangriff und verlangsame den Gegner mit einem Sprung auf seinen Kopf.
Spanish: Salta por encima de su ataque volador y salta sobre su cabeza para ralentizarlo.
Italian: Salta per evitare il suo attacco volante, poi saltagli sulla testa per rallentarlo.
Turkish: Uçarak saldırdığında üzerinden atla, sonra yavaşlatmak için kafasına zıpla.

English: Beware of their super fast charge attack and stun them as fast as possible!
French: Méfie-toi de leur attaque super rapide et assomme-les le plus vite possible !
Japanese: [!TR] Beware of their super fast charge attack and stun them as fast as possible!
German: Vorsicht vor dem superschnellen Superangriff. Betäube den Gegner so schnell wie möglich!
Spanish: ¡Ten cuidado con su ataque de carga superrápido y atúrdelo tan velozmente como sea posible!
Italian: Attenzione alle loro cariche rapidissime: stordiscili appena puoi!
Turkish: Aşırı hızlı hücum saldırılarına dikkat et; olabildiğince çabuk sersemlet!

English: Will charge if it sees you! Best to Charge Whip when its back is turned!
French: Il va t'attaquer s'il te voit ! Mieux vaut lui donner un Coup de fouet quand il a le dos tourné !
Japanese: [!TR] Will charge if it sees you! Best to Charge Whip when its back is turned!
German: Superangriff bei Sichtkontakt! Setze die Superpeitsche ein, wenn dir der Rücken zugedreht wird!
Spanish: ¡Cargará si te ve! ¡Será mejor azotarlo cuando esté de espaldas!
Italian: Se ti vede, ti attacca! Usa la frusta caricata quando ti volta le spalle!
Turkish: Seni görürse hücum eder! Arkası dönükken Yüklü Kırbaç kullanmak en iyisi!

English: Stay out of range of its beam attack, then Charge Whip its aura away!
French: Reste hors de portée de son rayon, puis donne un Coup de fouet sur son aura pour la supprimer !
Japanese: [!TR] Stay out of range of its beam attack, then Charge Whip its aura away!
German: Bleib außerhalb der Reichweite des Strahlenangriffs und entferne die Aura mit der Superpeitsche!
Spanish: ¡Permanece fuera del alcance de su rayo de ataque, después azota su aura!
Italian: Rimani fuori dalla portata del suo raggio, poi usa la frusta caricata per neutralizzare l'aura!
Turkish: Işın saldırısının menzilinden uzak dur, sonra aurasını Yüklü Kırbaçla dağıt!

English: Watch out for its deadly flop attack, then Charge Whip its aura away!
French: Méfie-toi de son attaque mortelle nulle, puis donne un Coup de fouet pour supprimer son aura.
Japanese: [!TR] Watch out for its deadly flop attack, then Charge Whip its aura away!
German: Nimm dich vor dem verheerenden Plumpsangriff in Acht und entferne die Aura mit der Superpeitsche!
Spanish: ¡Ten cuidado con su mortal ataque de sacudida, después azota su aura!
Italian: Fai attenzione al suo attacco in caduta, poi usa la frusta caricata per neutralizzare l'aura!
Turkish: Ölümcül debelenme saldırısına dikkat et, sonra aurasını Yüklü Kırbaçla dağıt!

English: Avoid its downpour of throwing axes, then Charge Whip its aura away!
French: Évite son déluge de lancers axiaux, puis donne un Coup de fouet pour supprimer son aura.
Japanese: [!TR] Avoid its downpour of throwing axes, then Charge Whip its aura away!
German: Weiche den herabfallenden Wurfäxten aus und entferne die Aura mit der Superpeitsche!
Spanish: ¡Esquiva su lluvia de hachas y después azota su aura!
Italian: Evita la sua pioggia di asce, poi usa la frusta caricata per neutralizzare la sua aura!
Turkish: Yağmur gibi fırlattığı baltalardan kaç, sonra aurasını Yüklü Kırbaçla dağıt!
